name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731

lifecycle.note: Weights remain downloadable from the deepseek-ai Hugging Face organisation. In the DeepSeek API the model was retired on 2026-09-10; the legacy name deepseek-v4-flash now routes to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.

replacedBy.note: In the DeepSeek API: V4-Flash was retired on 2026-09-10 and deepseek-v4-flash temporarily routes to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.

released.note: Released in the DeepSeek API as a public beta under the unchanged model name deepseek-v4-flash; the V4-Pro API and the app and web models were not changed by this update.

summary.text: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 is the official, non-preview release of DeepSeek-V4-Flash, with open weights under the MIT License, served in the DeepSeek API from 2026-07-31 under the unchanged name deepseek-v4-flash. DeepSeek says it keeps the preview's architecture and size and differs in renewed post-training. It was retired in the API on 2026-09-10.

changes.text: Ships with an attached DSpark speculative decoding module; DeepSeek says architecture and size are otherwise unchanged and only post-training was redone.
Reasoning effort is set through a reasoning_effort parameter with three levels: low, high and max.
Natively supports the OpenAI Responses API format and is adapted for Codex.
DeepSeek reports substantially stronger agentic capabilities than the preview.

features.note: Reasoning effort levels low, high and max.

notes: The card calls it the official release of DeepSeek-V4-Flash, superseding the preview, with the same model structure as DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark (a speculative decoding module attached). The change log says it keeps the architecture and size of the preview and was only re-post-trained; no parameter count or context window is restated for it, so both are left out. Release date from the change log; the Hugging Face repository was also created on 2026-07-31 (hub metadata, not stated on a page). The API retirement on 2026-09-10 is recorded in notes and replacedBy, not as a retired date, because the weights remain available.
